title: Agentic · Wire mechanical guard into adversarial benchmark
mission: Integrá el guard ejecutable scripts/compiled-dispatch-mechanical-enforcement-lib.mjs al benchmark adversarial existente sin tocar la fixture ni fabricar cobertura. El caso PROSE_ONLY_SUCCESSOR_POLICY debe perder su mechanical_enforcement estructural y fallar antes de dispatch. Conservá visibles los otros misses todavía no cerrados, false-positive violations=0 y el requisito de residual honesty. Esta unidad sólo cablea/verifica el benchmark; no afirma todavía que el allocator productivo invoque el guard.
definition_of_done: agentic_adversarial_correction_benchmark_v1.mjs importa y ejecuta validateMechanicalEnforcement además del validator estructural existente.
El baseContract incluye un mechanical_enforcement estructural válido y PROSE_ONLY_SUCCESSOR_POLICY lo elimina explícitamente.
MECHANICAL_ENFORCEMENT deja el miss set por fallo ejecutable del guard, no por cambios en la fixture o aceptación.
Los contextual negative controls siguen con 0 violations y los misses no cubiertos siguen visibles.
Persistir resultado con conteos before/after y límite explícito de que el live allocator wiring sigue pendiente.
allowed_scope: coordination/portfolio/tests/mechanical_enforcement_contract_v1.mjs only if a compatibility adjustment is required
scripts/compiled-dispatch-mechanical-enforcement-lib.mjs only if a bounded regression defect is found
forbidden_scope: modifying the adversarial fixture to relax MECHANICAL_ENFORCEMENT acceptance
claiming allocator/live enforcement from benchmark-only evidence

semantic_identity.problem: the executable mechanical enforcement guard exists but the adversarial benchmark does not consume it so the named miss remains outside regression coverage
acceptance: benchmark imports and executes validatemechanicalenforcement for every baseline contract
contextual false-positive violations remain zero and the original fixture is not relaxed
mechanical_enforcement leaves the residual miss set while unrelated residual misses remain visible
prose_only_successor_policy removes the structural mechanical gate and is rejected before dispatch

truth_boundary: This job improves deterministic benchmark coverage only. Live allocator enforcement remains a separate integration requirement until independently wired and verified.
